Ivy: Heads up 1!
We've been getting flaky JSON payloads from browser clients when we switch some services to gRPC. Proposal: add a lightweight per-request "transport toggle" header clients can set to pick json or grpc. Default still governed by routing policy. Need: safe override semantics, console visibility, telemetry for quota/cost delta, and a tidy canary flow. Thoughts?

Diego: I like a header approach: X-RW-Transport: grpc|json. Two constraints:
1) Overrides only allowed for tenants with a feature-flag (safety)
2) Header should be honored by edge only after policy evaluation (policy decides whether overrides are permitted)

Priya: Agreed. Also, in Console we should surface a "Transport Rollout" card per-tenant showing: current percent routed to grpc, json fallbacks, top validation failures, and estimated cost delta if json is used (because we lose binary KV caching). Make the rollback button flip the tenant flag immediately.

Ivy: On telemetry: emit route_chosen, override_used (true/false), fallback_code (PROTO_MISSING|TRANSCEIVER_TIMEOUT|VALIDATION), quota_burn_units, and token_cost_estimate. Send as structured trace/log attributes so the Console and SLO alerts can query them.

Diego: Implementation sketch:
- Policy engine has default rule: route_policy(default: grpc)
- Tenant flag dev.transport_override = false
- Edge evaluates policy -> if flag true and header present -> honor header, else ignore header
Pseudo-policy example:
```
route_policy {
  default: grpc
  overrides {
    allow_if: tenant.flag("dev.transport_override") == true
    header: "X-RW-Transport"
  }
}
```

Priya: For canary UX: start with 1% of global traffic but also allow tenant-targeted canaries (list of tenant ids). Console card should show a small sparkline for latency and a stacked bar for routed_by (policy|override|fallback). Add a tooltip explaining why fallback happened.

Ivy: We also need auto-rollback rules: if json_fallback_rate > 0.5% OR token_cost_estimate delta > 20% over a 30m window -> rollback and notify SRE + tenant owner. Make this configurable per-rollout.

Diego: Edge caveat: JSON path loses our fast KV key prefix cache. We'll need a per-tenant cost projection stored on the rollout object so product can approve.

Priya: Instrumentation: add a span transport.selection with attributes {route, override, fallback_code}. Aggregate in Tempo to find hot paths. Also surface counts by fallback_code in Metrics (Prometheus) for dashboards.

Ivy: UX question: should we allow client SDKs to expose this header easily? Maybe set a flag in the SDK (sdk.transport = "json") that sets the header but warns developers that it only works if tenant is allowed.

Diego: Example curl for manual test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-RW-Transport: json" \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

ops-bot: deploy edge-routing v1.4 -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark:

Priya: Next steps: Ivy to write RFC with policy DSL + Console mock; Diego to prototype edge header handling and policy check; I'll draft the rollout card design and Prometheus metrics list. Link work items here when created.

Ivy: Will do. Creating RFC now and linking shortly. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
